worldcombat.skill.nightmare.summary: Presses a nightmare onto an already sleeping opponent: the shadows count down, and when it finishes — if the target is still in the same sleep and within reach — it drains a share of maximum health at once, and the pain of that drain wakes it, the nightmare dispersing with the waking. It only works on a sleeping target, and the drain is a share of maximum health ignoring defence and type. Waking early, a cleanse, the sleeper being put back to sleep, or the caster leaving reach all end it at once. A sleeping-immune boss can never be cursed.
worldcombat.skill.nightmare.use.0: Cash in a sleep window you or an ally made
worldcombat.skill.nightmare.use.1: Press one delayed heavy blow onto a sleeper
worldcombat.skill.nightmare.use.2: Force an opponent to spend a cleanse or come protect the sleeper
Curses only an already sleeping enemy within %1$s blocks and a clear line; when the shadows finish counting down it drains %2$s of the target's maximum health at once. It settles as a share of maximum health, with neither defence nor type involved, but a higher Sp. Def drains less; the drain wakes the sleeper.

The shadows press for about %1$s before the harvest; it completes while the target stays asleep, in the same sleep, with the caster still in reach. If the sleeper is woken early by any damage (including the harvest), the nightmare stops and the shadows are cut; a refreshed or replaced sleep, a cleansed carrier, or being out of reach at the harvest also disperses it, and a fresh sleep does not inherit the old countdown.
worldcombat.skill.nightmare.deep.on: Deep dream: one harvest ×1.15, but a slower countdown (+15 ticks, about 45), +2 ticks wind-up and +6 ticks cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.nightmare.deep.off: Light dream: one harvest ×0.85, but a faster countdown (about 30 ticks), settling earlier in the sleep window.
worldcombat.skill.nightmare.growth.1: From level %1$s the harvest is %2$s and the reach %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.nightmare.preference.d: On: one harvest ×1.15, but a slower countdown (+15 ticks, about 45), +2 ticks wind-up and +6 ticks cooldown — a heavier press. Off (light dream): one harvest ×0.85, but a faster countdown (about 30 ticks), settling earlier in the sleep window.
worldcombat.skill.nightmare.preference.a: A sleeping target is only considered within this distance; beyond it the partner walks in first instead of casting from afar. Larger lets it press in from farther away.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to curse.
